top_signals.title: Gold Miner Cadillac, Backers Raise C$385 Million in Canada IPO
top_signals.summary: Cadillac Mines Corp. and some of its backers raised C$385 million ($273 million) in an upsized initial public offering, adding to the mining-driven rebound of listing activity in Canada.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: What the ‘Chinamaxxing’ crowd doesn’t get
top_signals.summary: When survival and success depend on pleasing the party boss rather than the consumer, honest innovators are weeded out.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Volkswagen CFO addresses plant closures, job losses as profits sink
top_signals.summary: German auto giant Volkswagen on Friday reported weaker-than-expected second-quarter profit and revised down its sales forecast for 2026.
